headline: Salesforce releases SOV-Transcribe-1, Apache 2.0 speech-to-text model
quote: We’re releasing the weights today on Hugging Face under the Apache 2.0 license.
claim: Salesforce released SOV-Transcribe-1, a 4B-active (26B total) open-weight ASR model under Apache 2.0, reporting 2.28% AA-WER versus 2.81% for NVIDIA's Nemotron 3.5 Transcribe, with rankings as of 12 Nov 2026.
why_it_matters: A permissively licensed transcription model you can self-host for voice agents; check the vendor-reported benchmarks yourself before relying on them.
title: Introducing Salesforce SOV-Transcribe-1: #1 Open-Weight Model Built for Real-World Speech

headline: Zyphra releases ZONOS3-Mini, 100M-active open text-to-speech model
quote: It runs in real time on phones and laptops, including directly in the browser.
claim: Zyphra's ZONOS3-Mini is an open-source text-to-speech model with 100 million active parameters, 43 languages including Hindi, Bengali and Tamil, voice cloning, and Apache 2.0 weights; the card lists llama.cpp, Ollama and LM Studio usage.
why_it_matters: A tiny TTS model with Indian-language support that runs on a laptop or in the browser, good for local voice projects.
title: Zyphra/ZONOS3-Mini · Hugging Face
